title: Local LLM runtimes

groma:
  id: local-llm-runtimes
  technology: HTTP (OpenAI-compatible / Ollama API)
---

LLM servers running on the developer machine or LAN: Ollama, LM Studio, GPT4All, Jan, llama.cpp, Exo clusters, Nativ and any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Ollama also serves the nomic-embed-text embedding model used by RAG, and Ollama/LM Studio serve fill-in-the-middle completions.
